name: inspect_adb_window
description: Report the window manager's current focus declarations (mCurrentFocus and mFocusedApp from `dumpsys window windows`, or from `dumpsys window displays` when the windows section declares neither, as on Android 16) — what is on screen at read time without any interaction. Read-only.
